description: Create a prepaid credit top-up invoice payable via Indonesian QRIS (all banks and e-wallets) at a flat rate of Rp 0.20 per credit (Rp 1,000 = 5,000 non-expiring credits). Use this tool when the user wants to purchase additional credits; do not use it to check whether an existing invoice has been paid (use check_billing_and_qris_status instead). Requires PUSHNOTIF_API_KEY, generates a PENDING order valid for 30 minutes at 0 fee, and automatically credits the workspace upon payment webhook confirmation; if both package_id and custom amount_rp are supplied, amount_rp takes precedence (minimum Rp 1,000). Returns JSON { ok, order: { id, amount_rp, credits_added, status, qris_checkout_url, expires_at } }.

amount_rp.description: Custom top-up amount in Indonesian Rupiah (minimum 1000, maximum 10000000; 1 IDR = 5 lifetime credits, overrides package_id)

package_id.description: Preset package tier: 'starter' (Rp 20,000 = 100,000 credits), 'growth' (Rp 50,000 = 250,000 credits), or 'pro' (Rp 100,000 = 500,000 credits); ignored if amount_rp is explicitly provided

name: create_qris_invoice
